text: A female figure with long black hair, pale skin, and a slender build stands in profile. She wears a floor-length purple gown with high slit sides, black trim, and bell sleeves. Her face is oval, featuring red lips, dark eyes, and dangling earrings. A headband adorns her forehead. She poses with arms slightly outstretched, one hand near hip. Other panels show front, back, and side views of the same figure in identical attire.
